mapper.sql: R.ROOM_ID, R.REQUEST_ID, R.USER_NO, R.FIXER_NO, R.CATEGORY_CODE, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, CU.NAME AS USER_NAME, FX.NAME AS FIXER_NAME, RQ.TITLE AS REQUEST_TITLE, CC.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME

FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN USERS CU ON CU.USER_NO = R.USER_NO LEFT JOIN USERS FX ON FX.USER_NO = R.FIXER_NO LEFT JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS RQ ON RQ.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.CODE_ID = R.CATEGORY_CODE
mapper.select: SELECT RQ.REQUEST_ID, RQ.USER_NO, RQ.CATEGORY_CODE, (SELECT E.FIXER_NO FROM ESTIMATES E WHERE E.REQUEST_ID = RQ.REQUEST_ID AND E.STATUS = 'SELECTED' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS FIXER_NO FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS RQ WHERE RQ.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (REQUEST_ID, USER_NO, FIXER_NO, CATEGORY_CODE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{requestId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{userNo}, #{fixerNo, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{categoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT , (SELECT M.CONTENT FROM (SELECT CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID DESC) M WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M2 WHERE M2.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M2.SENDER_NO != #{userNo} AND M2.READ_AT IS NULL) AS UNREAD_COUNT
WHERE R.USER_NO = #{userNo} OR R.FIXER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY R.ROOM_ID DESC
SELECT USER_NO FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = 'surit_support'
SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'INQUIRY_TYPE' AND NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CODE_ID
SELECT MAX(ROOM_ID) FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND REQUEST_ID IS NULL

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.USER_NO, R.CATEGORY_CODE, CC.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, (SELECT M.CONTENT FROM (SELECT CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID DESC) M WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT M.SENT_AT FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(SENT_AT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID DESC) M WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS LAST_SENT_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M2 WHERE M2.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M2.SENDER_NO != #{userNo} AND M2.READ_AT IS NULL) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM R LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.CODE_ID = R.CATEGORY_CODE WHERE R.REQUEST_ID IS NULL AND R.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY R.ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.USER_NO, U.NAME AS USER_NAME, R.CATEGORY_CODE, CC.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, (SELECT M.CONTENT FROM (SELECT CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID DESC) M WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT M.SENDER_NO FROM (SELECT SENDER_NO FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID DESC) M WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS LAST_SENDER_NO, (SELECT M.SENT_AT FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(SENT_AT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID DESC) M WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS LAST_SENT_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M3 WHERE M3.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) AS MSG_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = R.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.CODE_ID = R.CATEGORY_CODE WHERE R.REQUEST_ID IS NULL )
(LAST_SENDER_NO IS NULL OR LAST_SENDER_NO != #{supportNo})
LAST_SENDER_NO = #{supportNo}
ORDER BY ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.ROOM_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.MESSAGE_TYPE, M.CONTENT, M.FILE_PATH, TO_CHAR(M.SENT_AT, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT, TO_CHAR(M.READ_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS READ_AT, U.NAME AS SENDER_NAME FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = M.SENDER_NO WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.MESSAGE_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.ROOM_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.MESSAGE_TYPE, M.CONTENT, M.FILE_PATH, TO_CHAR(M.SENT_AT, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT, TO_CHAR(M.READ_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS READ_AT, U.NAME AS SENDER_NAME FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = M.SENDER_NO WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.MESSAGE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit} ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (ROOM_ID, SENDER_NO, MESSAGE_TYPE, CONTENT, FILE_PATH, SENT_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderNo}, #{messageType}, #{content, typeHandler=com.surit.chat.util.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, #{filePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT NAME FROM USERS WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
